capabilities: Browse HTML files as live thumbnails
Search files by name, title and content
Open notes that link to each file
Filter and sort the gallery by folder
Insert embed links to unlinked files in the current note's folder
disambiguation: Not an image gallery; its main job is browsing HTML files, with PDF, SVG and image support as optional switches.
extras: Requires enabling "Detect all file extensions" in Obsidian settings or the gallery stays empty. Does no OCR, so scanned PDFs are only findable by file name. On mobile, the gallery opens via the command palette or toolbar since there is no ribbon.
problem: Obsidian has no way to browse HTML files visually, so you must remember file names or folder locations to find generated diagrams and documents.
summary: File gallery that shows HTML files (plus optional PDFs, SVGs and images) as live thumbnails, searchable by title and content, with links to referencing notes.
